analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The single changed head line (1409) adds a table row documenting `decodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks` (4 for the Qwen 3.5 family, 0 otherwise) in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift. The supplied units (base lines 1607-2419) are unchanged surrounding documentation. They cover MTP, sampling, reasoning parsers, tool calls, vision limits and MiMo native loading, and none of that text is modified. This is a documentation-only change with no code, config, key-handling, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing logic touched, so no threat-model assumption (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, T-041 and others) is invalidated. The knob interleaves decode steps between prefill chunks. That is a scheduling and latency behavior that could affect availability (T-010, T-029) or timing side channels (T-041/SEC-035 same-account TTFT oracle). The supplied evidence does not show the implementation, so I cannot assess it. Integration should confirm the corresponding code change in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (not supplied here) does not alter cancellation, deadline admission or cache behavior. The patch excerpt is truncated, but the range map is complete and shows only one added line. No finding is reported.
